Lead: a subject or technique for the in-app / runtime deploy contract, where the committed manifest is replaced by reconciliation of untracked remote state — a shape this repo already invented independently (cloudAdoptDeployment, src/api/system/cloud.ts:96, plus CloudReconcileBanner).
